verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own bulk capabilities: a case import API for batch-creating many cases at once, batch filing of reports to FinCEN, multi-file attachment import, and bulk export of case data for a time frame. These are narrow, though, and nothing shows bulk edits, status changes, reassignment or dispositioning across many existing cases. Missing for 10: bulk update/disposition/reassign of many existing cases, multi-select bulk actions in the UI, detailed API docs on batch limits and behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Hummingbird also supports batch creating cases over the case import API. This is preferable for use cases where it's desirable to create many cases all at once
Batching Filing enables a filing organization to send filings to FinCEN in batches instead of one filing at a time.
You can add one or more attachments (bulk import) in the Files tab from within a case
This will download case data for the time frame selected, including case comments.
